jobs.occupation: Senior Quantitative Developer - European Gas Fundamentals
jobs.description:
Join us in this role where you’ll help design and develop our new European gas supply–demand modelling capability, supporting short- and medium-term trading and portfolio decisions. You’ll combine strong Python development skills with quantitative modelling and market analysis, working closely with experienced energy market specialists and traders. This is an opportunity to shape the technical foundations of an important new modelling capability and see your work directly influence commercial decisions.

Welcome to Forecasting & Market Analysis You’ll join a collaborative team of quantitative developers and market analysts developing fundamental models, forecasts, and analytical tools across European gas and power markets.

You’ll play a central role in building our European gas modelling capabilities, working alongside colleagues with complementary expertise in energy fundamentals, quantitative modelling, and software development.

As a team, we collaborate across disciplines, share knowledge, and continuously improve how we model and understand energy markets.

You’ll play an important role in:

• co-developing and enhancing our new European gas supply–demand model, supporting gas trading, market analysis, and portfolio management.

• designing scalable, reliable Python-based models and contributing to their architecture, implementation, and continuous improvement.

• modelling fundamental gas market drivers, including pipeline supplies, LNG imports, storage dynamics, consumption, infrastructure constraints, and cross-border flows.

• developing quantitative methodologies to analyse market balances, assess scenarios, and understand short- and medium-term market developments.

• integrating and processing diverse market datasets, ensuring data quality, transparency, and reliable model outputs.

• improving model performance, automation, testing, documentation, and deployment through modern software engineering practices.

• collaborating closely with gas analysts, traders, and other developers to turn complex market questions into practical modelling solutions.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have strong experience in Python development, quantitative modelling, software engineering, or a related field.

• can design and build scalable, maintainable, well-tested quantitative applications and data processing pipelines.

• have a solid understanding of numerical methods, data analysis, time series, or statistical modelling.

• are comfortable working with SQL, version control, automated testing, and collaborative development practices.

• enjoy translating complex real-world problems into robust, practical models.

• are intellectually curious about energy markets and motivated to understand the fundamental drivers behind market behaviour.

• communicate effectively and enjoy collaborating with people from different technical and commercial backgrounds.

It would be an advantage if you also bring:

• experience with European natural gas, LNG, power, or other commodity markets.

• previous experience developing supply–demand, fundamental, forecasting, or scenario models.

• familiarity with European gas market datasets, infrastructure, and price formation.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Do you enjoy turning complex data into clear choices that help VELUX use resources wisely? As S&OP Specialist, you will work across functions to develop scenarios and recommendations that support senior management in making key planning decisions.

Meet your future team

You will join Global Planning – S&OP & Planning Excellence, a team that collaborates cross-functionally with Marketing, Regional Management, Supply and Finance to support connected planning processes across VELUX. The team consists of six colleagues based in Skjern and Kolding.

The S&OP Specialist is a new role in the team, introduced to ensure better alignment across functions in the planning processes.

What We Offer

As S&OP Specialist, you will support the Global S&OP process by consolidating market input, preparing scenarios and creating decision material and recommendations for senior management. You will bring structure to S&OP preparation and ensure that agreed decisions are translated into clear planning requirements.

As part of your onboarding, you will be introduced and trained in the current Demand Planning processes and tools to build your understanding of the VELUX supply chain and planning processes.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Ensure that worst/best case sales scenarios is agreed and aligned with the regional management in key markets and understand their assumptions, risk and opportunities.

• Support the global Demand Planning Network in coordinating market input, sales uncertainties, campaigns, allocation requirements and scenarios.

• Plan and facilitate Pre-S&OP meetings and prepare topics that require decisions.

• Develop and evaluate scenarios with Sales, Supply, Purchasing, and Finance, including implications for service, inventory, capacity, production, costs and financial performance.

• Prepare clear decision material for Global S&OP meetings, outlining alternatives, business trade-offs, risks and required decisions.

• Document decisions and follow up on actions, deadlines and outcomes, while translating agreed decisions into input for Master Planning.

This role can be based in Skjern, Kolding, Østbirk or Hørsholm and you can expect minimal traveling in Denmark and abroad.

What You Will Bring Into The Organization

You bring experience from a planning-related role and understand how decisions on demand, supply, inventory and financial priorities connect across the value chain and have translated that understanding into measurable business outcomes.

You combine curiosity and structure with a commercial mindset and business acumen; you can challenge assumptions constructively and connect planning decisions to customer needs, operational trade-offs and financial performance.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring experience from Demand Planning, S&OP, Integrated Business Planning, Supply Planning, Master Planning, Sales Forecasting or Supply Chain Analysis in fast-moving consumer goods.

• Have extensive understanding of S&OP and end-to-end supply chain planning, including how planning decisions affect service, capacity, inventory and production.

• Have advanced Excel skills, experience using Power BI for analysis and reporting, and familiarity with SAP BW/BWP data structures and data extraction.

• Have the financial understanding needed to assess business cases and quantify the implications of scenarios for costs, inventory, revenue and overall business performance.

• Can establish constructive working relationships with stakeholders across functions and levels to ensure that decisions, assumptions, responsibilities and actions are transparent and followed through.

• Can translate data-based scenarios into simple, clear visualisations that enable decision makers to compare options, understand key trade-offs and make informed decisions.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, "courage" and "mutual respect" define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At VELUX, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all - whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager – AI | Shape the Future of Construction Tech with Dalux
jobs.description:
Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how construction professionals find information, understand complex project data, automate repetitive work, and make decisions.

We're looking for an AI Product Manager to help turn those possibilities into products that create real value for our users.

As an AI Product Manager at Dalux, you'll operate at the intersection of customer needs, rapidly evolving AI technology, and business strategy. You'll work closely with Product Design, AI engineers, developers, and other Product Managers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve construction workflows – and equally importantly, where it cannot.

Building AI products is different from traditional software development. Outputs are probabilistic, quality needs continuous evaluation, and product decisions involve trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, scalability, and user trust.

You'll help us navigate those trade-offs and establish how we build great AI products at Dalux.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• AI Product Discovery: Identify and validate problems where AI can create meaningful value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users and internal domain experts to understand construction workflows and identify opportunities for AI-powered improvements.

• Evaluation & Quality: Define what "good" looks like for AI features and establish evals, quality metrics, test cases, and feedback loops.

• AI Safety & Trust: Consider hallucinations, uncertainty, guardrails, failure modes, explainability, and user trust throughout product development.

• Feature Ownership: Lead AI-powered features from early experimentation and prototyping through delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with AI engineers and developers on model capabilities, context, architecture, latency, scalability, and cost.

• AI Product Strategy: Follow developments in models and AI technology and help determine which technological advances create meaningful opportunities for Dalux.

**About You

**We are looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with a solid understanding of modern AI.

You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you need enough technical understanding to make informed product decisions and have meaningful discussions with the engineers building these systems.

We believe you:

• Have experience building or managing customer-facing AI/ML products.

• Understand concepts such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, context, agents, evals, and guardrails.

• Understand the fundamental difference between building deterministic software and probabilistic AI experiences.

• Can translate rapidly evolving technical capabilities into valuable user experiences.

• Are comfortable defining and measuring quality where traditional acceptance criteria are insufficient.

• Think critically about when AI is – and isn't – the right solution.

• Can balance user value, model quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Experience with B2B SaaS is an advantage.

Experience with construction technology is welcome but not required. We have deep construction expertise within Dalux – for this role, we are particularly interested in adding strong AI product expertise to our organization.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

Sparrow Quantum is seeking a talent acquisition and HR partner to lead recruitment and grow into a broader HR role

• Type: Permanent, full-time position

• Compensation: According to qualifications

• Location: Copenhagen

• Start date: February 1, 2027 (flexible)

• Reports to: VP of Finance

About the role

Sparrow Quantum is growing fast, and the people we hire in the coming years will shape what the company becomes. We are looking for a talent acquisition and HR partner who can lead our recruiting efforts and grow with our HR function.

Recruitment is the core of the role. You will own hiring from the first conversation with a hiring manager to the signed contract, across scientific, engineering, and commercial roles, in Denmark and internationally. Some travel might be expected.

Initially, your focus will be on talent acquisition. Once core hiring is under way, you will gradually take on more of the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding, with support from external HR partners. HR at Sparrow Quantum is a function under development, and the role will grow with it, with a path towards Head of HR.

Responsibilities

Core responsibilities - leading talent acquisition

• Own the full recruitment process, from role definition with hiring managers to offer and contract-signing

• Source and attract candidates for specialist roles in quantum photonics, engineering, and production, as well as business functions

• Work with our Communications & Marketing Manager on building our employer brand and a talent pipeline, including attending job fairs at local and international universities

• Own our applicant tracking system, and report on hiring progress and time to hire

• Manage recruitment agencies, where they add value

• Coordinate with our Office & Admin Manager on work permits and relocation for international hires

• Source scientists and engineers through academic networks, conferences, and research groups, and run technical screening together with hiring managers

Career growth - HR across the employee life cycle

• Design onboarding that integrates new colleagues quickly

• Own retention initiatives, including employee surveys and follow-up on the results

• Support on building performance reviews and development paths for our employees

• Run offboarding, including exit interviews and knowledge handover

• Be the first point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions

• Keep contracts, policies, and HR documentation compliant with Danish employment law

Building the function

• Prioritize which HR processes, policies, and tools to build first as the company scales

• Manage our collaboration with external HR partners

• Advise management on workforce planning, organization ,and compensation, together with the VP of Finance

Who we are looking for

You are an HR professional with a strong recruitment profile, and you want to grow into or take on a broader HR role. If you don't already have experience within quantum or deep tech, then you should have a keen eye and an ability to learn quickly, so you can help find the best candidates for our team. And you should be excited by the prospect of being part of a company that's on a growth journey, where each day is often different from the next.

Must-haves

• 2 to 6 years of experience in HR, with a clear focus on recruitment

• A clear wish to broaden into HR, from onboarding and development to offboarding

• Working knowledge of Danish employment law and practice

• A structured way of working and sound judgement with confidential matters

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice-to-haves

• Experience within deep tech, research, or tech, and at a start-up or scale-up

• Experience recruiting scientists or engineers, ideally internationally

• Experience working with Teamtailor and its HRIS Aboard

• Experience setting up HR processes or an applicant tracking system from scratch

• Experience with work permits for non-EU hires

• Experience working with external HR or recruitment partners

What we offer

• Working in a highly motivated team of passionate people at the forefront of photonic quantum technology

• Competitive salary + company paid pension

• DSB Business Card

• Private health insurance

• Flexible working hours and ability to work remotely temporarily

• Six weeks of paid vacation and paid family leave

• Lunch subsidized by the company

• Company phone and company credit card

• Opportunities to attend conferences and workshops

• Steep learning curve in a supportive environment within a rapidly expanding industry

Why Sparrow

• Passionate International Team – Join a group of committed professionals where your perspective and initiative have a direct impact

• Cutting-Edge Projects and Collaborators – Work with world-leading researchers and innovators to shape quantum technology's future

• Growth and Learning – Be part of a supportive culture with mentoring, knowledge sharing, and opportunities to evolve your role

• Career Progression – Grow into project leadership, operations, or funding strategy based on your strengths

• Inclusive Culture – We value diversity and prioritize employee well-being and flexibility

How to apply

Submit your CV and a short cover letter in English via our website: https://sparrowquantum.com/position?id=8695575

We review applications as they arrive and may close the position early, so apply soon. The final deadline is December 1, 2026. For questions about the role, contact Andreas Olesen ao@sparrowquantum.com .

We are committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities.

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies and is widely recognized as a leader in single-photon sources.

Our first product is an on-chip single-photon source that delivers more than 20 million high-quality single photons per second into an optical fiber, used by customers for applications such as multi-photon quantum simulation and quantum key distribution.

The patented technology builds on more than two decades of research by founder Peter Lodahl and the Hy-Q Center of Excellence at the Niels Bohr Institute in Copenhagen. Learn more at www.sparrowquantum.com.

**

Build Intelligent Systems That Create Real Impact

Are you motivated by solving complex problems with data and AI?

Do you enjoy transforming business challenges into scalable, production-ready solutions?

At VENZO, we’re expanding our Data & AI team and are looking for experienced profiles across mid-to-senior level — from strong hands-on engineers to technical leaders who can shape architecture and guide others.

At VENZO, we believe in the power of technology to create meaningful change – today, not tomorrow.

You’ll join a team of specialists who live and breathe digital transformation, helping some of Denmark’s largest and most influential organizations turn data into action. Here, innovation isn’t a buzzword – it’s how we think, collaborate, and deliver.

What You Can Expect From Us

About the role

Are you an experienced Project Manager with a solid understanding of IT integrations and a talent for creating structure, progress and strong working relationships?

Scan Global Logistics is looking for a hands-on Technical Project Manager to support a major global transformation programme involving the implementation of new systems, global processes and data migration.

The programme implements a new Transportation Management System (TMFF), Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, and a Vendor Invoice Management solution (Basware and AP Essentials.

As Technical Project Manager, you will play a key role in driving and coordinating integration projects across teams, integration specialists and business stakeholders.

Your primary responsibility will be to create structure, draft plans, ensure progress and make sure that tasks, responsibilities, dependencies and deadlines are clearly defined and followed up.

You will act as the link between diverse teams and the business, helping translate technical challenges into clear business requirements – and vice versa.

This is not a developer role. However, you should have a good technical understanding of integrations, data flows and system dependencies, enabling you to engage confidently in technical discussions and challenge proposed solutions when needed.

You should also enjoy getting involved in the practical aspects of project management, including communication, documentation, process descriptions and mapping integration flows. It is a must that you know when to support and when to drive tasks, content, colleagues to ensure progress.

Key responsibilities

• Drive and coordinate integration projects across implementation and integration teams and vendor teams, i.e., integration to e-invoicing governmental portals

• Act as the link between technical teams, system owners, implementation teams and business stakeholders.

• Create structure, clear priorities, realistic timelines and well-defined project plans.

• Ensure proper task management and follow-up in Jira.

• Make sure tasks are clearly described, assigned to the right people and followed through to completion. You support the integration team with describing their tasks, flow descriptions, etc.

• Coordinate resources, dependencies and delivery schedules across teams.

• Support the documentation of integration flows, system dependencies and processes.

• Translate technical issues into business requirements and ensure alignment between business and IT.

• Follow up on progress, identify bottlenecks and help resolve issues before they impact delivery.

• Coordinate testing, deployment and operational handover where relevant.

Your background

We are looking for someone with solid experience in technical project management and, in particular, system integration projects.

You do not need to be a technical specialist or developer, but you must understand how systems communicate and how integrations work.

Ideally, you have:

• Experience managing IT integration projects.

• A good understanding of APIs, CSV, data flows and integration patterns.

• An understanding of system dependencies and how different applications interact.

• Experience coordinating technical teams, developers or integration specialists.

• Experience with project planning, resource coordination, and delivery follow-up.

• Experience using Jira or similar project management tools.

• The ability to create clear documentation, process descriptions and integration flow diagrams.

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, ERP or TMS solutions is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Experience from logistics and transportation is also an advantage, but we are equally interested in candidates from finance, operations or other industries who have moved into IT and integration projects.

Who are you?

Your personality will be just as important as your technical and project management experience.

You are someone who can create momentum and gain the respect of others without relying on formal management authority.

You are structured, detail-oriented and persistent when it comes to following up and ensuring that things get done.

At the same time, you are approachable and understand the importance of building good relationships.

You are comfortable working with different personalities, handling disagreements and challenging existing ways of working in a constructive manner.

You know when to push and when to listen. You can stand your ground without being overly dominant, and you understand that successful project delivery depends on bringing people along.

You are pragmatic, have a good sense of humour and can navigate different situations with confidence and good judgement.

The team

You will report to the Programme Lead and work closely with integration specialists, system owners, workstream leads, implementation project managers and solution architects to mention just a few.

What we offer

• An important role in a major global transformation programme.

• An international working environment with colleagues across different countries.

• A role combining technical insight, project management and relationship building.

• The opportunity to make a visible difference to project delivery and collaboration.

Location: Hvidovre is preferred, but Viby is also an option for the right candidate.

**Travel:**Approximately once a month between locations.

Contact

The recruitment process is handled by EPICO Group. If you have any questions about the position, please contact: Mia Mûller, Senior Delivery Manager, Email: mbm@epico.dk, Prone: +45 2866 3943.

Why Scan Global Logistics?

At Scan Global Logistics, you will join a global growth company with an entrepreneurial spirit and a fast-paced environment. You will play a central role in a strategic transformation with high visibility and the opportunity to make a real impact.

Scan Global Logistics is a leading Danish logistics and transportation company headquartered in Hvidovre, Denmark. We provide global solutions within sea, air and road freight as well as supply chain management, helping businesses move their goods safely and efficiently around the world.

Are you interested in gaining hands-on experience within Global Procurement at one of the world's leading jewellery brands? Do you enjoy working with data, analysis, and stakeholder collaboration in a dynamic international environment?

Pandora is looking for a Student Assistant to join our Global Procurement team. In this role, you will support sourcing activities, procurement projects, and business analysis across different spend categories while working closely with category managers and stakeholders across the organisation.

This is a unique opportunity to gain valuable insight into procurement within a global organisation operating across the full value chain. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you will contribute to sourcing activities, supplier management, data analysis, and process improvements while building both professional skills and practical business experience.

Key Responsibilities

You will be exposed to a variety of tasks within Procurement and collaborate with stakeholders across all levels of the organisation. We expect you to take ownership of your responsibilities and contribute proactively to ongoing projects and initiatives.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Support Procurement colleagues with various procurement activities

• Contribute to sourcing projects and tenders across spend categories

• Project manage smaller projects and tasks independently

• Conduct data analyses and create business insights

• Create and deliver presentations for internal stakeholders

• Assist with the implementation of new processes across the global organisation

• Engage in dialogue with suppliers on various topics, including compliance-related activities

• Support data quality initiatives and ad hoc administrative tasks related to contract management

Your Team

Working in Global Procurement, you will join a team that partners with stakeholders across Pandora to drive value through strategic sourcing, supplier collaboration, and continuous improvement initiatives across a broad range of indirect spend categories.

The Global Procurement team is part of the Group Commercial organisation. You will work alongside more than 20 skilled colleagues in an international and collaborative environment and report to the Director of one of our Indirect Procurement categories.

You will be part of an exciting business area and work in an international hub of passionate, performance-driven, and can-do spirited colleagues.

Qualifications

You might be the person we are looking for if you are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree and ideally have at least two years remaining before graduation.

We hope you can demonstrate:

• Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree or similar in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Economics, or Data Management

• Excellent communication skills in English

• Strong Excel skills and an analytical mindset

• A genuine interest in Procurement and related disciplines

• Great interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships across different functions

• A flair for creating professional and impactful presentations in PowerPoint

Personal Competencies

We are looking for someone who is:

• Proactive, curious, and eager to learn

• A humble and enthusiastic team player

• Comfortable working independently and taking ownership

• Structured and detail-oriented in their approach

• Not afraid to take initiative and responsibility

• Ambitious and motivated to develop professionally

You Will Get

A position as Student Assistant in Global Procurement offers an opportunity for both personal and professional development in a global organisation.

You will get:

• Valuable work experience from a globally recognised brand within Procurement across different spend categories

• Exposure to a fast-moving and dynamic environment where our people and values are at the centre of what we do

• A chance to challenge yourself and apply what you have learned in a global business environment

• Support and coaching from your manager as well as a diverse and experienced team

• Flexible working hours, especially around exam periods

Additional Information

This role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

You are expected to work approximately 15-20 hours per week on average (less during exam periods and more when possible and required).

Did We Get Your Attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

Icing on the Cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.

Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery using 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030.

Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

New Power Partners is looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the delivery of complex construction and building projects across Europe.

The role is responsible for managing projects from planning and procurement through construction and handover, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and to the highest quality and safety standards. The Senior Project Manager will work closely with clients, consultants, contractors, and authorities, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the project lifecycle.

In addition to project delivery, the role includes supporting business growth through client development, tender support, and identifying new opportunities. As the business expands, the successful candidate will play a key role in mentoring colleagues and, over time, helping establish and develop a team of project managers and specialists.

About Site Solutions

Site Solutions develops and delivers turnkey solutions for the onshore and offshore wind industry – covering everything from facilities and workforce logistics to operational planning and site coordination. We work closely with global project teams to ensure efficient site setups that keep projects running smoothly and safely.

Site Solutions is a great team of nine employees, and the Senior Project Manager will work closely with all team members while contributing both strategically and operationally to the development and delivery of our services.

While our heritage is rooted in the wind industry, we increasingly support customers across construction, infrastructure and industrial sectors where temporary site facilities are critical for successful project execution.

What the role offers

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery

• Lead construction and building projects from initiation to completion.

• Manage scope, schedule, budget, quality, and project risks.

• Coordinate clients, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and authorities.

• Ensure projects comply with applicable regulations, HSE requirements, and quality standards.

• Provide clear project governance, reporting, and stakeholder communication.

Commercial & Client Management

• Build and maintain strong client relationships.

• Support tendering, procurement, and contract management activities.

• Manage project commercial performance, including budgets, forecasts, variations, and claims.

• Identify opportunities for additional services and long-term client collaboration.

Business Development

• Support business growth through networking, client engagement, and market development.

• Contribute to proposals, commercial discussions, and new project opportunities.

• Help strengthen New Power Partners' position within the Danish construction sector.

Team Development

• Mentor and support junior project managers and consultants.

• Share knowledge and best practices across projects.

• Support recruitment and onboarding as the team grows.

• Contribute to building a collaborative and high-performing project organization.

Qualifications & Experience

• Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Building Technology, or a related discipline.

• 8+ years of project management experience within the Danish building and construction industry.

• Proven track record delivering commercial, industrial, residential, infrastructure, or mixed-use projects.

• Strong understanding of Danish construction processes and regulations.

• Experience with contract management, procurement, and stakeholder management.

• Familiarity with AB18, ABT18, and ABR18 is an advantage.

• Fluent in Danish and English.

Key Competencies

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills.

• Commercially minded with sound contractual understanding.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.

• Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented.

• Ability to balance hands-on project execution with business development.

• Leadership potential with an interest in developing people and teams.

Success in the Role

Success will be measured by:

• Safe and successful project delivery.

• High client satisfaction and repeat business.

• Strong financial and commercial project performance.

• Development of new business opportunities.

• Contribution to the growth of the project management team and the wider business.

Why join New Power Partners?

You will work in an international project environment, collaborate with experienced colleagues and customers, and play a role in shaping the future of Site Solutions.

This role is ideal for an experienced Senior Project Manager who enjoys delivering complex projects, building strong client relationships, and contributing to the growth of both the business and future project teams**.

**

Global Business Development Manager

Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

**About The Role

In this pivotal role, you will be essential in supporting our innovative ventures beyond tobacco, using strategic insights and a strong understanding of global market trends. **

jobs.description:
**Job Description

**Interest rate markets move constantly, and the people who understand them shape how risk is managed for clients across the region. Joining our Derivatives Trading team you will be working directly with experienced traders and building practical expertise in interest-rate options from day one.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will be part of a close-knit trading team where analysis, precision, and curiosity matter every day. Working within Derivatives Trading, you will support the pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions, monitor market developments, and collaborate with colleagues across sales, quant, risk, and operations.

More specifically, you will:

• Support pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions under experienced traders

• Monitor interest rate markets, volatility, and economic developments with the team

• Analyse portfolio exposures and help manage risk within agreed limits

• Build and improve tools for pricing and risk monitoring using Python or similar languages

• Collaborate with sales, quant, risk, and operations colleagues to support accurate trade processing

**About You

**You are a recent graduate or have up to two years of relevant experience in trading, quantitative analysis, asset management or a related field. Previous trading experience is not required. We are interested in your analytical ability, curiosity and willingness to learn.

• Degree in economics with a technical focus, alternatively in mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related quantitative field

• Strong numerical and analytical skills with a structured approach to problem solving

• Genuine interest in fixed income markets and a desire to build a career in trading

• Programming ability in Python or a comparable language, applied to practical problems

• Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language

• Sound judgement, attention to detail, and willingness to ask questions and raise concerns

Familiarity with derivatives, probability, statistics, or numerical methods is an advantage, though no prior trading experience is required. Academic projects, relevant coursework, or internships are all useful ways to demonstrate your analytical interest.

**What We Offer You

**This role offers structured learning through direct collaboration with experienced traders, with responsibility growing as your knowledge deepens. This is a full-time, in-office role with daily access to colleagues who are invested in your progress and development.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, apply by submitting your CV, cover letter and grade transcripts. If you have any questions before applying you can reach out to hiring manager Frederik Dimo-Ungermann at fdi@danskebank.dk.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Finding new routes beyond roads. That’s us.

Mercedes-Benz is on an exciting journey of transformation. Our purpose is defined as “First Move the World.” We aim to be at the forefront of innovation, not only in automotive technology and luxury, but also in shaping a more sustainable and connected future. By combining pioneering products and services with a strong customer focus, we continue to set new standards in safety, digitalization and design.

Mercedes-Benz Danmark A/S is the general distributor for passenger cars, vans and aftersales products in Denmark. Working as part of the Sweden and Denmark cluster, we support our authorized retailers and workshops with sales, marketing and business development.

To strengthen our Danish used-car business, we are now looking for an analytical and commercially minded Used Car Specialist. The position is based at our office at Digevej, Copenhagen. You will be a part of a team across border and expect to travel to our Swedish office, based in Hyllie Malmö, on a regular basis.

**About The Position

**As Used Car Specialist, you will play an important role in driving our used car and remarketing activities in Denmark together with the team. You will combine commercial insight, data analysis and operational coordination to help ensure competitive pricing and efficient vehicle sales. Working closely with dealers, auction and remarketing partners, as well as Sales and other internal stakeholders, you will turn market data into clear recommendations and help create a professional, efficient vehicle journey from return to sale.

**Your main responsibilities within the team will include:

**

• Drive remarketing performance by analyzing sales, stock, pricing and market data and translating insights into commercial action.

• Own the remarketing journey from returned to sale.

• Enable high-quality vehicle sales by securing accurate documentation, equipment descriptions and vehicle data.

• Build strong partnerships with Danish dealers, auction platforms, logistics providers and other remarketing partners.

• Support the team in improving processes, reporting and data quality across the remarketing journey.

**Who Are You

**You are analytical, structured and curious about understanding what drives business performance. You enjoy working with data and figures, but also appreciate collaborating with colleagues, dealers and external partners.

You are proactive, detail-oriented and motivated to learn new skills in a dynamic commercial environment.

**We believe you bring:

**We believe you are at the beginning of your career with approximately 1-3 years of experience from a similar position. Your educational background could be within business, finance, economics, sales, automotive management or a related field, but we will also look at candidates with a different educational background with curiosity so don’t hesitate to apply.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data and market developments into action.

• Solid Excel skills and the ability to work with large datasets.

• Commercial understanding, combined with a structured and quality-conscious approach.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills and ability to build trustful relationships with our dealers and partners.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

Experience from the automotive or used car industry, vehicle appraisal, trade-in activities or auction and remarketing platforms will be considered an advantage.

**What We Offer

**This is an opportunity to take on a varied and commercially important role at the center of the Danish used-car business. You will have the chance to influence remarketing performance, pricing decisions and residual-value development while working closely with dealers, partners and colleagues across the Mercedes-Benz organization.

You will join an international and collaborative environment where data, customer focus and continuous improvement are central to how we work. The role offers broad stakeholder exposure and a genuine opportunity to strengthen how we manage and develop the vehicle lifecycle in Denmark.

**Application

**For position specific information please contact Thomas Larsson thomas.larsson@mercedes-benz.com . For general information about the recruitment process, please contact Evelina Hofstedt, HR Partner at evelina.hofstedt@mercedes-benz.com .

We are keen to get the right candidate onboard as soon as possible; therefore, we practice continuous selection. So don't wait with your application, send it as soon as possible, however no later than 25th November. Please apply using the link below; we do not consider applications received via email.

We are one of the world’s most successful automotive companies. With its divisions Mercedes-Benz Cars, Mercedes-Benz Vans and Mercedes-Benz Financial Services, the Mercedes-Benz Group is one of the biggest producers of premium cars and the world’s biggest manufacturer of commercial vehicles with a global reach. Mercedes-Benz Financial Services provides financing, leasing, fleet management, insurance and innovative mobility services.

**We’re looking to expand our Copenhagen team with a **Senior Consultant / Solution Architect

**with a management consulting background and the expertise to design and implement SAP IBP solutions.

**What you’ll do

**As a senior member of our team, you’ll be working in the sweet spot **where consulting meets deep solution expertise.

**Specifically, you will:

• 
**Design end-to-end supply chain planning processes

**and facilitate key decisions with senior stakeholders

• 
**Step into the subject-matter expertise role,

**knowing how SAP IBP can improve demand, response & supply, inventory and/or S&OP

• 
**Bridge the gap between business and IT

**by translating client needs into robust, value-adding solutions while being able to challenge the client on the status quo

• 
**Drive project delivery from blueprint to go-live

**, ensuring meaningful client impact

• 
**Support business development

**through your consulting experience and client network in the Nordics

In addition to facilitating change management initiatives, you’ll be working with a team of younger consultants, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality project delivery.

**What you’ll bring

**We’re looking for a seasoned consultant who combines structured thinking, technical depth, and a collaborative mindset. In the best-case scenario, you bring:

• **At least 4 years

**of **client-facing

**experience at a **management consulting firm

**, demonstrating strong team collaboration and interpersonal skills.

• Proven expertise **designing and delivering

**in one or more **SAP IBP solutions

**(demand, response & supply, inventory, S&OP)

• Strong capabilities and interpersonal skills to **facilitate workshops

**, align stakeholders, and articulate complex solutions through **clear PowerPoint storytelling

**

• Deep understanding of **supply chain planning processes and operating models

**

• A relevant master's degree (e.g., in Supply Chain, Engineering, or Business)

• A collaborative, entrepreneurial spirit – and a desire to reshape how consulting is done in the Nordics

**What we offer

**Our Planning Excellence team across EMEA has seen substantial growth over the past few years, thanks to our strong subject-matter expertise and our ability to drive effective change management in organisations seeking to transform their planning operating model.

Joining us means entering a world of:

• A unique culture of **freedom, trust, and responsibility

**

• Opportunities to work on **transformational projects

**with leading organisations

• A **flat organisation

**where your ideas and initiatives matter from day one

• A strong, performance-based compensation model

• A **growing, entrepreneurial international team

**backed by a strong Scandinavian brand

Your mission

As our Carbon Removal Supply Lead, a new role here at Klimate, you will build and own the systems, data, and market intelligence of our carbon supply sourcing. You will strengthen sourcing as a function and enable strategic and commercial decision-making grounded in strong supplier relationships, accurate market information, and well-governed internal data.

You will sit within the Sourcing team and report directly to Matt Averna, Head of Markets & Policy.

About Klimate

At Klimate, we enable companies pursuing real climate action to take responsibility for the emissions they can’t avoid. The world talks a lot about net-zero, but most companies struggle to know what to do once reductions are no longer enough. That’s where we come in. We are a science-led business with real experts guiding companies through the world of carbon removal and how they can safely invest in taking CO₂ out of the atmosphere. Our solution combines expertise, guidance and software to help companies understand what’s real, what works, what it costs, and how to do it credibly.

Founded in 2020, we are a tight-knit team of around 20 people from a great variety of nationalities united by a passion for scaling solutions to the climate crisis. We move quickly when it matters and focus on sharing ownership along the way. Besides working in teams we enable that ownership in squads making it possible for all employees to lead areas, they are passionate about. We value deep collaboration and working side-by-side in our central Copenhagen office, from where we support leading clients including Storebrand, Dalberg, OC&C, and many others.

You can get to know us a bit better on our website or on LinkedIn.

What you'll do

• Become fluent in Klimate’s sourcing priorities, supplier base, and contracting approach for carbon removal projects.

• Independently prepare for and contribute to supplier meetings, using structured data and clear market context.

• Support and share responsibility of supplier meetings, preparing materials and ensuring learnings are captured in internal systems.

• Manage projects and contracts in Klimate’s administrative inventory system, coordinating with internal stakeholders where needed.

• Take ownership of existing supplier and project data across sourcing systems, ensuring it is well structured, consistent, and up-to-date.

As you grow into the role, you will:

• Serve as a sparring partner to sourcing leadership and relevant internal teams on sourcing focus, market coverage, and portfolio construction.

Director, Platform Engineering – Accelerate the SaaS transformation behind one of the world’s leading media platforms

Do you thrive at the intersection of organizational leadership, platform engineering, and SaaS transformation? Are you motivated by building teams and shared capabilities that enable other engineers to move faster, operate with greater autonomy, and deliver at scale?

At Stibo DX, we are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering to lead a strategically important engineering domain and drive our transition toward SaaS.

The role

As Director of Platform Engineering, you will lead three global teams responsible for Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery. Together, these teams provide shared platform foundations, deployment capabilities, gateway infrastructure, APIs, and supporting services used across the Cue media enterprise platform.

Your primary mission is to accelerate the SaaS transformation. You will develop the domain into a coherent platform-engineering organization that provides standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities, enabling application teams to deploy and operate their services without the Platform Engineering organization becoming a central delivery bottleneck.

A central part of the role is to establish clear organizational boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, and Operations. You will help shape a model in which Platform Engineering provides the shared foundation and developer enablement, while application teams remain accountable for the behavior, reliability, and operational outcomes of the services they build.

You will also lead the organization through this transition. Stibo DX is building toward a SaaS-first future while continuing to support self-hosted and hybrid customers. The role therefore requires someone who can balance the target state with pragmatic migration paths, preserving customer value while steadily reducing complexity and fragmentation.

Reporting directly to the CTO and serving both as a member of the Development Leadership Team and the company-wide Senior Leadership Team, you will lead a domain of 14 people and contribute to the continued development of both your domain and the wider engineering organization. The role can be based at any of our Stibo DX offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, Oslo, or Málaga.

Key responsibilities

You will lead and develop a distributed engineering organization while creating the structure, capabilities, and momentum required to scale Stibo DX’s SaaS transformation. The role combines organizational leadership, platform strategy, developer enablement, and operational discipline, and requires close collaboration with Product Management, Architecture, SRE, Operations, and other engineering leaders.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop the distributed Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery teams.

• Build a coherent platform-engineering organization with a shared mission, clear ownership, and strong execution.

• Accelerate the SaaS transformation by translating strategic direction into platform capabilities, adoption paths, and measurable outcomes.

• Provide standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities that enable application teams to deploy and operate services independently.

• Treat the platform as a product, with clear internal users, priorities, adoption measures, and feedback loops.

• Establish clear boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, Operations, and Architecture.

• Drive platform adoption with the other Development leaders while keeping application migration and operational ownership within the application domains.

• Balance development of the target SaaS platform with pragmatic transition paths for self-hosted and hybrid customers.

• Build a culture of trust, accountability, constructive challenge, continuous improvement, and company-first leadership.

The ideal candidate

You are first and foremost an experienced engineering leader. You know how to create clarity, build effective teams, and translate strategic direction into coordinated execution across a complex engineering domain. You have successfully led distributed engineering teams in an international environment and bring experience from a customer-facing SaaS company or an organization transitioning toward SaaS delivery models.

You understand that developer enablement is how platform engineering scales. You know where a central platform team should build reusable capabilities, where it should provide standards and guardrails, and where application teams must retain ownership. You measure success through adoption and autonomy, not through the amount of work centralized in the platform organization.

You bring sufficient technical depth in platform engineering and SaaS to engage credibly with senior engineers and architects, understand trade-offs, ask incisive questions, guide the overall direction, and recognize whether teams are progressing toward a coherent and scalable platform. You are not expected to be hands-on or to act as the chief platform architect. Your role is to create the conditions for strong technical decisions and hold the organization accountable for sustained progress.

You are a strong people leader known for building trust, developing talent, and creating an environment where accountability, ownership, and continuous learning thrive. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally across organizational boundaries, and contribute to the success of the wider company rather than focusing only on your own area.

Relevant experience

• Proven leadership experience from platform engineering, cloud-native engineering, developer platforms, or a closely related area.

• Experience leading multiple distributed engineering teams through organizational and technological change.

• Experience with customer-facing SaaS products and the organizational changes required to support SaaS-first delivery models.

• Broad understanding of platform engineering, internal developer platforms, self-service, AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, APIs and gateways, observability, security, reliability, and cloud economics.

• Experience modernizing an established software platform while continuing to support legacy, self-hosted, or hybrid customer environments.

• A demonstrated ability to strengthen adoption of shared platforms and improve autonomy for application teams.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to align across engineering, product, architecture, and operations.

• Fluency in English, spoken and written.
